sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Suresh C. Dwivedi Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
The petitioners herein claims to challenge the award dated 03.11.2022 prepared by competent authority under Section 23 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
The remedy before the petitioner is to file reference under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
The prayer made in the petition is misconceived and is accordingly, dismissed.
Order Date :- 13.2.2023
